principle: Architecture work is now completely independent from the site's previous design. Existing rendered pages are compatibility shells only; they carry no visual, layout, animation or component authority into the future redesign.
architectureGuard: No architecture decision may be justified by the needs or limitations of an existing layout. Existing layouts may only be touched when required to keep routes/build/data access functional during architecture migration.

afterArchitecture.rule: Build a new layout system without inheriting previous site design assumptions.
afterArchitecture.reference: Use current Sites design progress as a reference at redesign time, not as an architecture dependency.
afterArchitecture.preserve: content, stabilized architecture, verified assets, canonical identities and useful compatibility routes
